description.value: New District is a well-regarded private liquor store on Vancouver's west side, carrying over a thousand wines alongside a deep selection of craft beer, spirits, and cider. The shop prides itself on knowledgeable staff who can source hard-to-find limited releases and natural wines. It also runs a bimonthly wine club and regular in-store tasting events for locals and visitors alike.
